name: Kleptocracy and Grand Corruption Proceeds
description: Laundering of funds misappropriated or extracted by senior officials and their networks, often through complex corporate structures, family members, luxury assets and international banking. Detection depends on PEP risk management, source-of-wealth understanding and scrutiny of unexplained wealth relative to official income.

sources.text: FATF, Laundering the Proceeds of Corruption (2011)
FATF, Guidance on Politically Exposed Persons (Recommendations 12 and 22) (2013)
World Bank StAR and UNODC, Politically Exposed Persons: Preventive Measures for the Banking Sector (2010)
World Bank StAR, The Puppet Masters (2011)

indicators.name: Wealth disproportionate to official income
indicators.canon: Wealth or spending inconsistent with known means
indicators.desc: Assets, lifestyle spending or purchases clearly exceed the customer's known legitimate income or declared wealth, with no verifiable source.
indicators.ctx: A PEP or close associate holds assets, accounts or lifestyle spending far exceeding legitimate known earnings.
indicators.fp: Wealth can come from inheritance, prior private career or family business.

indicators.name: Accounts held via family members or associates
indicators.canon: Accounts held via family members or associates
indicators.desc: Funds and assets move through spouses, children, in-laws or business partners who have no obvious independent source of wealth.
indicators.ctx: Funds and assets move through spouses, children, in-laws or business partners who have no obvious independent source of wealth.
indicators.fp: Families commonly share finances and businesses.

indicators.name: Layered offshore entities and trusts
indicators.canon: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
indicators.desc: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
indicators.ctx: PEP-linked funds sit in multi-jurisdiction companies, foundations or trusts with nominee directors and no clear business purpose.
indicators.fp: Wealth planning and estate structures are often legitimately multi-layered.

indicators.name: Large inflows from state-owned entities or ministries to private accounts
indicators.canon: Large inflows from state-owned entities or ministries to private accounts
indicators.desc: Funds from government bodies or state enterprises arrive at private or personal accounts with no apparent contractual basis.
indicators.ctx: Funds from government bodies or state enterprises arrive at private or personal accounts with no apparent contractual basis.
indicators.fp: State suppliers and contractors receive government funds legitimately.

indicators.name: Prime real estate purchases in foreign cities
indicators.canon: Prime real estate purchases in foreign cities
indicators.desc: Acquisition of high-value property abroad through companies or relatives, inconsistent with declared means.
indicators.ctx: Acquisition of high-value property abroad through companies or relatives, inconsistent with declared means.
indicators.fp: Wealthy individuals legitimately invest in overseas property.

indicators.name: Adverse media on embezzlement or procurement fraud
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Credible reporting or enforcement action links the customer or associates to misappropriation of state funds.
indicators.fp: Media can be politically motivated or inaccurate, especially in repressive jurisdictions.

indicators.name: Rapid movement through correspondent or private banking channels
indicators.canon: Rapid movement through correspondent or private banking channels
indicators.desc: Large sums move quickly through several banks and jurisdictions after arrival, with no hold period.
indicators.ctx: Large sums move quickly through several banks and jurisdictions after arrival, with no hold period.
indicators.fp: Treasury and liquidity management can cause fast movements.

indicators.name: Luxury asset spending inconsistent with profile
indicators.canon: Luxury asset spending inconsistent with profile
indicators.desc: High-value purchases of yachts, jets, art, jewellery or education by a PEP-linked customer not explained by known income.
indicators.ctx: High-value purchases of yachts, jets, art, jewellery or education by a PEP-linked customer not explained by known income.
indicators.fp: Some customers have undeclared legitimate wealth sources not yet documented.
